standard_prerequisites.name: Local lifting through quasi-isomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Find gamma_i up to homotopy commuting with the presentations.

standard_prerequisites.name: Four and five lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Iso/surjection transfer along the map of long exact sequences.

core_obligations: Part (1), setup: choose presentations alpha_i, beta_i on a common refined covering and stupidly truncate K_i^* to degrees >= m+1; by the lift-through-quasi-isomorphism lemma find maps of complexes gamma_i : K_i^* -> L_i^* commuting with the presentations in D(O_{U_i}) (representing the derived maps by actual maps of complexes; the source summarizes some details) (proof lines 12072-12093).

The cone C(gamma_i)^* is strictly perfect (cone lemma); commutativity yields a morphism of distinguished triangles (K_i^*, L_i^*, C(gamma_i)^*) -> (K|_{U_i}, L|_{U_i}, M|_{U_i}); by the four/five-lemma the induced map on long exact cohomology sequences shows C(gamma_i)^* -> M|_{U_i} is an isomorphism in degrees > m and a surjection in degree m; conclude M is m-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 12094-12114).
Parts (2) and (3) follow from (1) by rotating the distinguished triangle (proof lines 12115-12118).
proof_roadmap: Lift the triangle map to a map of strictly perfect complexes.
Transfer the presentation through the cone with the four/five-lemma.
difficulty_reason: Part (1) builds the presentations for K and L on a common refined covering, lifts the triangle map to a map of complexes gamma_i through the quasi-isomorphism lift lemma (representing derived maps by actual maps of complexes; the bookkeeping is summarized in the source), takes the strictly perfect cone, and applies the four/five-lemma to the induced map of long exact cohomology sequences; parts (2) and (3) follow by rotation.
